4: Mateo wakes up at seven every morning, and every morning the same thing happens: he washes his face, he brushes his teeth, he gets dressed — and then he loses one sock. Valentina waits at the door with the bus tickets, looking at her watch. He always finds the sock at the last second, under the bed, and they always catch the bus by ten centimetres. What time do YOU wake up? Tell us your morning, step by step!
5: A traveller packs smart, says Sofía, and she folds one jacket, two jumpers and a pair of boots. Erik packs differently: he takes six shirts, no trousers and a machine that folds socks by itself — and does not work. In winter they wear scarves, in spring they wear light shirts. What do YOU wear when it is cold? Open your wardrobe and tell us!
6: Club survey! Erik walks around with a notebook: pasta or rice? Soup or salad? Mateo likes everything and answers yes to every question, which is not very useful for a survey. I like cheese but I don't like soup, says Erik, writing it down. And the milkshake? Everybody likes the milkshake. What do you like? What don't you like? Answer the survey and count the votes!
7: Market day! Sofía and Valentina need fruit for the club milkshakes. How many pears? Six. How much are the grapes? Not expensive. They buy lemons, two coconuts and a bag of carrots, and the bags are heavier every step. Luna carries nothing but walks in front like the leader of the expedition. How much is your favourite fruit? Come to the market and ask!
8: Every room tells a story. In Valentina's home there is a small kitchen that always smells of bread, and there are two bedrooms with blue doors. In Mateo's room there is a desk you cannot see, because there are papers, socks and one football on top of it. There are three lost pencils under his bed. What is in YOUR home? Take us on a tour, room by room!
9: Science in the garden! Erik is testing his new invention: a machine that waters the plants alone. Right now it is watering the flowers, the grass, the tree and — oh no — Sofía, who is reading on the bench. She is not laughing. The leaves are moving, the plants are growing, and the machine is still working. What is happening in your garden right now? Come and see!
10: Farm trip! Mateo runs to the field: look, a small horse! That is not a horse, says Sofía, that is a donkey. The cow can walk very slowly, the duck can swim, the hen can't fly very far and the goat can eat anything — including Mateo's map. What can these animals do, and what can't they do? Put on your boots and find out on the farm!
11: The lake is like a mirror today. Let's take the little boat! says Valentina. Let's have the picnic on that rock! says Erik. They row to the middle of the water, with the forest behind them and the mountain over everything. A fish jumps twice, very close. Let's stay here for ever — but the sandwiches are already finished. What shall we do today? Choose a plan and say Let's!
12: My backpack has got twenty-three things inside, says Erik proudly. Valentina looks at them one by one: a pencil case, a ruler, two rubbers, some glue, scissors, three notebooks… and a small stone. Twenty of these things you don't need, she says. Erik has got an answer for each one. Have you got a ruler? Have you got glue? Open your bag and count what YOU have got!
13: New class rules, written by the students! Rule one: we must help each other. Rule two: we must listen when someone speaks. Rule three: we mustn't shout in the corridor. Sofía writes them on a big poster with beautiful letters, and Mateo adds rule four: we mustn't run — and then he runs to hang the poster. What rules have YOU got in your class?
14: The best hour of the day: after school! Mateo likes riding his bike and skateboarding down the small hill. Erik likes reading science books and drawing his inventions, and he doesn't like watching TV. Both like playing outside until the sun goes down. What do YOU like doing after school? Tell us and find someone who likes the same thing!
15: Sports day! Green team against blue team, and Luna is the loudest supporter of both. Sofía runs fast, very fast, and she jumps high in the long jump. Mateo throws the ball well but catches it badly, so his team laughs and then wins anyway. Everybody runs, everybody claps. Who runs fastest in YOUR class? Come to the race and cheer!
16: Seven days, seven adventures! On Monday Valentina has dance class after school. On Wednesday Sofía goes to the library and comes home with four books. On Thursday they meet at the club house to plan the weekend. And on Friday? Club day — the best one of all. When do you play sport? When do you see your friends? Look at your week and tell us what you do on each day!
17: Picnic day by the fjord! Mateo carries the biscuits… well, most of the biscuits, because two of them disappear on the way. Would you like a sandwich? asks Valentina, opening the basket. Would you like some juice, or water? There is cake for everybody and one apple that nobody wants. Offer something to your friend today — and say it politely, like them!
18: Snow day! Put on your coat, put on your hat, put on your gloves — it's very cold outside! Erik goes out with all of it, plays for ten minutes, and comes back too warm: now he takes off the hat, takes off the scarf… and goes out again. Valentina laughs from the window with her cup of hot chocolate. Is it cold where YOU are? What do you put on to go out?
19: Question of the day: how does everyone come to school? Sofía comes by bus and knows the driver's name. Erik comes by bike, even in the rain, because his bike has got an umbrella on top — his own invention. Some children walk, some come by car, one comes by train. How do YOU go to school? Ask your friends and make a chart with all the answers!
20: Town tour for Mateo's cousin! First the playground, then the library where you must be quiet, then the swimming pool and the cinema on the corner. Where is the hospital? Behind the supermarket. Where is the school? Next to the park. Mateo gets lost twice in his own town, and Sofía finds the way twice. Where are these places in YOUR town? Draw the map!
21: The neighbour's cat is somewhere in the club house — and Luna knows it! Is it under the table? No. Is it behind the door? No. Is it between the boxes, next to the window, in front of the shelf? Valentina looks everywhere. Finally Mateo looks up: the cat is ON the cupboard, watching everybody, very comfortable. Where are your things? Say it exactly!
22: The new neighbours arrive today, so Erik and Sofía practise describing people. He has got short dark hair and glasses. She has got long hair and green eyes. The grandfather has got a white beard and he is quite old; the baby is very young. Nobody is 'normal' — everybody is different. Describe someone in your class and let your friends guess who it is!
23: In her grandparents' village, says Valentina, the bread smells like morning. There was a river with a stone bridge, and there were fields of yellow flowers behind the church. There was one small shop and there were no cars — only a quiet path where you could hear the birds. Sofía listens with her eyes closed. What was there in YOUR grandparents' place? Tell us!
24: Saturday jobs at the club house! Mateo has to feed Luna and sweep the floor. Erik has to wash the dishes and water the plants, but first he has to fix the machine that broke last week. Everybody has to take out the rubbish — nobody wants to. When the work is finished, the club house is clean and the afternoon is free. What do YOU have to do at home?
25: Sofía has got a cold, so today the Club meets at her window! What's the matter? asks Valentina from the garden. I've got a cough and a headache, and I think I've got a temperature, says Sofía from her bed with three blankets. Luna sits under the window all afternoon, waiting. Are you ill? Have you got a stomach-ache? Learn to say what's wrong!
26: Mateo's dentist day, and he is NOT happy. Open your mouth, please, says the dentist. You should brush your teeth twice a day, and you shouldn't eat sweets every afternoon. Erik takes notes, because he wants to invent a toothbrush that works alone. The medicine tastes terrible but the tooth is strong again. What should we do to stay healthy? Ask the doctor!
27: Yesterday the class visited the science museum! They walked around the big hall, they watched a film about the planets and they listened to a guide with a very loud voice. Valentina played with the light machine three times. Erik talked to the guide for twenty minutes and the bus waited for him. What did YOU do yesterday? Tell the story in the past!
